headline: Microsoft Research’s Quine links biological models, tools, literature, and scientists in one research harness

verified_story_context.summary: Microsoft Research introduced Quine as an early-stage research effort to build a multimodal world model of biology together with an interactive harness connecting models, scientific tools, literature, and researchers. A Quine Fellows program is intended to give scientists access to the system and generate scientific feedback from real research use.
verified_story_context.why_it_matters: Complex research domains may benefit more from systems that coordinate representations, external tools, literature, and expert feedback than from asking one model to answer every question from internal knowledge.

visual.layout: STRICT QUINE-SPECIFIC professional white-background scientific systems diagram. Place one large central hub labeled exactly “Biological world model”. Arrange five clearly distinct surrounding mechanism nodes labeled “Literature”, “Scientific tools”, “Biological modalities”, “Research harness”, and “Research feedback”. Use clean bidirectional arrows so evidence/tools/modalities feed the central model and research feedback returns through the harness. The biology research loop must dominate the full composition.
visual.mechanism: Central Biological world model ↔ Literature; central Biological world model ↔ Scientific tools; central Biological world model ↔ Biological modalities; Research harness visibly connects/orchestrates those interfaces; Research feedback returns through the harness into the Biological world model. Show multiple biological modalities conceptually (for example sequence, imaging, molecular/experimental data) without adding unsupported product names.
visual.alt_text: Professional scientific architecture diagram with a central Biological world model connected bidirectionally to Literature, Scientific tools, Biological modalities, a Research harness, and Research feedback.
visual.style: professional high-detail textbook/editorial scientific architecture; white background; crisp mechanism-first composition; legible non-overlapping text; no people, humanoid figures, cinematic scenes, stock imagery, dashboards, coding/repository diagrams, or decorative biology art
required_elements: one dominant central Biological world model hub
one Biological modalities node with conceptual sequence/imaging/molecular or experimental substructure
one Research feedback node represented without a person
clear bidirectional evidence/feedback arrows between the central model and surrounding research components
visual.text_policy: Use the six essential labels above as the primary readable text. Do not add provider names, model names, software-engineering workflow labels, metrics, benchmarks, promotional prose, or unsupported product UI. Short generic scientific modality descriptors may appear only if they support the biology mechanism.

correction_basis.correction: Remove all coding-agent/provider/repository/GPU/checkpoint concepts and force the Quine biology research-harness mechanism with explicit central hub, required nodes, and bidirectional research evidence/feedback loop.
